title: The Sixth Rank Swing
setup: White's g-pawn is ready to run and the black king on e1 is much too far away to have any say in it.
hint: Your rook has to meet the pawn in front, and it has to arrive with tempo. Which rank does both?
explanation:
## The Idea

Only one rank does the job. {{Rb6}} keeps the pawn under fire, and when it runs — {{g7}} — the rook swings across with check: {{Rg6+}} {{Kh2}} {{Rxg7}}. From b8 the rook can only block without check; from b5 it arrives behind the pawn, which is no use at all.
